layers.stated: Virtue burns the loveless as the sun burns a boneless creature.

note: The sun is a karu-like thing but carries no landscape; the comparison is of an action (burning). Fear is the effect, not a displayed feeling.

layers.stated: Why use harsh words when one knows how sweet words yield sweetness?

note: A rhetorical question; no image and no feeling the eight can name.

layers.stated: Impartiality is speech without bend, given no bend within.

kurippu.sense: bend: the tilt of a balance beam, carried in one word

note: The balance image is never stated; it rides on the word கோட்டம். நடுவுநிலை is one of the extra states of porul 6.12, not one of the eight.

layers.stated: Greatness counts for nothing in one who enters another's home without a millet's worth of thought.
Those who do not touch another's wife deserve good in this sea-girt world.

note: தோள் தோயா is love-poetry diction used for a puram admonition; the sea-ringed world is a frame, not a setting.

layers.stated: Do not seek gain by coveting; at harvest its fruit is bad.
He who tells others' faults will have his own picked out and told.
Long useless talk itself proclaims the speaker worthless.

note: The mockery is in the turn: no one needs to accuse him.

layers.stated: All one thinks of comes at once to one who does not harbour anger.

note: The ascetic setting is the commentator's, not the verse's; vaakai by extension.

layers.stated: If you can enjoy what you love unknown to others, enemies' plans fail.
Even the weak win if they choose the place and guard themselves.

note: War counsel is the one stretch where puram fits the Kural natively; no single battle thinai, so vaakai.

layers.stated: Saying is easy for all; doing as said is hard.
A fort is distinguished by deeds that fell the enemy at the battle front.

note: Porul 2.8: uzhinai is besieging and holding the fort. A native fit.

layers.stated: The world loves those who keep old, unbroken friendships.
The hostile-minded do not see the truth that brings victory.
Inner enmity, even as small as a split sesame seed, holds ruin.

note: அன்ன is an action marker in porul 7.12, but the shared quality is size.

layers.stated: The good woman Land laughs at those who say they have nothing and sit idle.

iraicchi.sense: the land itself, a mutal element, becomes the one who mocks

note: The land (mutal) given a voice and a laugh; nakai is displayed by the personified land.

layers.stated: When he looks, she softens and smiles gently.

note: Uri fixes the thinai; no setting or karu. Her smile is nakai from மடன், his voice is uvagai.

layers.stated: She will not blink lest he be hidden, yet the town calls him loveless.

kurippu.sense: the town may stand for the friend who blamed him

note: Alar (the town's talk) is an akam convention. The hidden-in-the-eyes conceit is not a comparison.

layers.stated: The esteemed lack everything if not loved by the one they love.

note: Lament of the unloved; thinai by uri only.

layers.stated: The funeral drum is beaten thrice, and the dying carry the dead.

iraicchi.sense: the drum beaten for the corpse is beaten for the bearers too

note: The drum (பறை) is literally one of the karu of porul 1.20.

layers.stated: Once the dancer has left the skin bag, what is done to the body does not matter.

note: Equanimity before the corpse: none of the eight fits.

layers.stated: Those who live on past austerity and do none now end at others' doors.
Base heart, your days are gone while you chase wealth: what will you do?

note: Addressing the heart as if it could answer is a convention named in porul 5.2 (நெஞ்சொடு புணர்த்தும்).

layers.stated: The great do not flare at insults; the base rant and butt a pillar.

note: Vekuli is depicted in the base man; its causes in porul 6.10 (injury, seizure, harassment, killing) do not include insult.

layers.stated: The nobly born keep doing good to those who harm them.
The restrained and content rarely suffer.
Gain wealth, the middle of the three, and you gain the others; lack it and suffer as if boiled.

kurippu.sense: the three aims are never named

layers.stated: The rich man's words carry; the poor man's glance off like a plough in dry soil.

note: Pastoral and ploughing images are karu of mullai and marutham, used without any landscape.

layers.stated: What the well-born do without means, the small will not do with them.

comparisons.vehicle: புல்வாய் பருமம் பொறுப்பினும் பாய்பரி மாபோல் பொருமுரண் ஆற்றுதல் இன்று

layers.stated: Friendship of the small lasts days; the bond of the steady holds like ascetics on their path.
True friendship opens like a tree flower and does not close like a pond flower.
Close but useless friends are worthless; seek the far friend who is like the field channel.
One who cannot feed the hungry at home had better go and be a guest elsewhere.

kurippu.sense: guest, and on one reading a guest of the other world, that is, dead

layers.stated: Bees do not visit a branch that has finished flowering; the ruined have no kin.

note: Full kurinji apparatus (the hill lord addressed, waterfall, bees) put to a puram truth. The tenor is stated in the last line, so this is open comparison, not ullurai.

layers.stated: Those who do not give are poor though rich; those who do not beg are great though poor.
Real shame is staying silent about what superiors did to one.

note: Defines நாண், which is in the porul 6.12 list, not among the eight.

layers.stated: As the tiger starves rather than eat prey fallen on its left, the excellent refuse heaven if it costs honour.

comparisons.vehicle: கடமா தொலைச்சிய கானுறை வேங்கை இடம்வீழ்ந்த துண்ணா திறக்கும்

layers.stated: The crooked cannot hear virtue, as the tanner's dog cannot taste milk-rice.
What matter whether they live or die, who see life may go in a blink and do no good?
When the king guards well the worthy follow; the grasping king is a pouncing tiger.

note: Second half uncertain.

layers.stated: Austerity and virtue are the boat across the sea of deeds.
The elements and the gods from Sadasiva go out within Shakti to tend space and earth.

note: Cosmology. No thinai describes it.

layers.stated: Fire takes earth, mountains, seas and space; the knowing heart feels no wonder.

note: The verse names and refuses marutkai: வியப்பில்லை. Kaanchi at cosmic scale.

layers.stated: Even breath in both partners gives a fair child; faltering breath gives none.

note: Procreation by breath: a couple, but not akam. Life (breath) shapes the body.

layers.stated: Whatever people know, they perish without noticing their time cut away.

note: The numbered kinds of knowing are uncertain; the kaanchi line is plain.

layers.stated: A sign on the head tells whether six months or one remain.

note: Signs of death as technique, not as lament; kaanchi's feeling is missing.

layers.stated: With no earth, water, stalk or root a lotus blooms; with no town a light is seen.

ullurai.tenor: the lotus of the crown or of awareness

note: Keeps the karu (the lotus) and negates its mutal (land, water, place, up and down). A riddle in the ullurai mould.

layers.stated: Think of her with flowing hair in the place of no night or day; join her in silence.

ullurai.tenor: Shakti, the union as a yogic state

note: Akam diction (the woman, union) with time explicitly negated.

layers.stated: He is in me as life in flesh, pours like the cloud, and I become the Lord of space.

note: The verse states the life-in-flesh analogy directly.

layers.stated: Above the cosmic mountain the bliss tattva pervades as the thirty-six.

note: Tattva cosmology.

layers.stated: Seeing the light within the three mansions ends the body's reckoning.

ullurai.tenor: the three bodies or yogic regions

layers.stated: Turiya purifies the soul; the vision of the Supreme lies in his pervading.

note: Ends in உபசாந்தம், the calm that has no place among the eight.

layers.stated: Those who cannot reach the guru's mark wander talking; what can they gain beside those who dance?
It is not filled, named or joined, for nothing is beside it; it shows itself without cause.

note: Negative theology; no feeling, image or setting.

layers.stated: Master the nine paths of the lying senses and you can mount the horse of truth.

ullurai.tenor: breath or body as the vehicle of ascent

layers.stated: Nandi, joined to me, is refuge only to those who have cast off falsehood.

kurippu.sense: joined hands (a marriage phrase) and mingled in body or truth

layers.stated: Wasting embryo, bonds, fear and births and righting the mind, the skilled reach the Supreme.

note: Technical and uncertain.

layers.stated: She of tender eyes saw the Dancer and sang the Vedas.
Burning the noose of the unruly jackal, he lived sweetly at home with the jewelled woman.

ullurai.tenor: the unruly mind and its bonds

note: Ends in the householder-love close of karpu (இல்லத்து இனிதிருந்தான்); thinai assigned by that close, weakly.

layers.stated: If he leaves me in birth, let it be whole and fortunate, then take me into service.
When will my life leave the sea of bought pleasure for the sea of silent Siva-bliss?

note: The praise section is a marutham landscape (fields, fish, areca, moat) attached to a temple town: karu surviving as place-praise.

layers.stated: Drawn to women like a needle to a magnet, he asks for a day he wears the lotus feet.
Remove this pot of flesh and fluids and grant release.

kurippu.sense: this pot (body) and that pot, on a pun of கடம்

layers.stated: Keep me from the lewd sorrowful trade of women; look on me with grace.

note: The Valli story brings kurinji karu (millet field, kura grove) into the praise: kalavu inside paadaan.

layers.stated: Free me from desire for dancing women and grant the meaning you told Siva.
A string of prayers: a mind beyond the senses, Tamil praise, release, splendour.
For a love-sick girl burned by the moon and Kama's arrows, come and give her life.

note: Akam in form: a friend or mother pleads for the girl; midnight is kurinji's hour (porul 1.7). Perunthinai because the longing is excessive and one-sided.

layers.stated: Do not let this deer-like girl perish: come, look, join her, or give your kadamba garland.

note: The flute is the karu of porul 1.20 (யாழின் பகுதி); the garland plea is a classic akam token.

layers.stated: Fearing death's rope, the pyre and the weeping kin, he asks for the flower feet.

note: A kaanchi scene embedded in paadaan.

layers.stated: A rubbish-minded slave of women, he asks Murugan to scold him like a mother and teach him.

note: Self-abasement is இளிவு, a cause of azhugai (porul 6.5), not ilivaral.

layers.stated: When will yoga grow, the diseased body fall away, and Murugan sit in his breast?
Without the devotees' virtues, he asks not to drown in women and vows never to forget the feet.
On the day old age and disease ruin the body and the soul is in distress, give grace.

note: The textbook ilivaral of porul 6.6 (மூப்பே பிணியே). Also kaanchi's முதுமை (porul 2.19).

layers.stated: When Death's host drags me to hell, will the fragrant feet not come?
I, a dog, drowned in union with women; give me love to praise your feet.
Before kin grieve, the pyre is lit and Death binds the life, give me the mind to praise you.

note: Funeral and Death's rope: kaanchi inside paadaan.

layers.stated: Rid of the madness women give, will I strive to worship you?
Even when my mind is lost in passion, give me ways to praise your feet.

note: The frankest uvagai in the sample, set as the background to the prayer.

layers.stated: Let Sivam leap into me, my form become yours, and you come on the peacock with the meaning.
You never leave me; when will I never leave you?

note: The pulambal refrain; no feeling among the eight.

layers.stated: Think, mind, of Siva: all things reverse, the body is a stinking cage; melt like lac in fire before him.

note: Kaanchi (impermanence) and ilivaral (the body's openings) in one agaval, closed by paadaan.

layers.stated: Wandering for prey and circling the pit of women, I am alone; rule me, Kalathi.
Shall I not see the cause of the dark throat, and him among the devotees?

kurippu.sense: the poison drunk to save the world, unnamed

layers.stated: As my influence grew a new delusion came and I walked head downward to ruin.

note: The section title is இறந்தகாலத்து இரங்கல்: irangal used outside akam.

layers.stated: Not seeing Rudra in the heart in truth, I lost my purpose and was confused.
Food given to the sense-conquered reaches the Lord; giving to idle wanderers is waste.
Kindle fire in the root channel and drink that water; through the lady you reach the Lord.

note: Yogic technique; the coded terms decide everything.

layers.stated: Fools, raise the root channel as the bull climbs the opened sluice.
Book-carriers babble lies and do not know where they die and are born.
It must not be said; you have seen aloneness.

note: Silence; nothing for the frame to hold.

layers.stated: Deeds appear without appearing in the pure space: void.
To sing the kummi on the Maiden, Nandi's golden feet are our protection.

note: Porul 2.27: கடவுள் வாழ்த்து opening a work. The kummi is a play-song.

layers.stated: We will make the eight nagas dance and bind the unbindable snake.

note: The Siddhar's boast is perumitham by daring; the snake is coded.

layers.stated: Lightning-creeper, lamp, vine, sugar: we have scolded these names of women away.

note: A list of akam-style epithets for the woman, rejected: the akam vocabulary quoted in order to be refused.

layers.stated: Raising thought from the root through sushumna to the bindu, we joined bliss.
Talk is error; flawless inquiry is what is needed.
Those who multiply gods and gurus, never seeing the hill of rising, are cattle bound for hell.

kurippu.sense: the hill of rising, a yogic place

layers.stated: Fix the reversed breath in Brahman; the arrow joins the sky and the coats fall away.
Do not heed garbed renouncers who talk for their belly; do not say body and life are two.

note: உடலுயிரென் றுரைத்திடாதே: the one verse in the sample that names body and life together and refuses to split them.
